description_html: Established in 2005 as Danaher Attig & Plante PLC, our Vermont office joined forces with Prosperity Partners to enhance our depth of expertise and client service. description_html: Cendrowski Corporate Advisors (CCA) is a nationally recognized advisory firm with more than 40 years of experience serving closely held businesses, private equity firms, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals. Known for expertise in forensic accounting, business valuations, REIT/UPREIT structuring, family office services, and complex tax planning, CCA specialists have also authored leading books on private equity, fraud deterrence, risk management, and more—widely regarded as essential references by educators and business leaders. In 2024, CCA merged with Prosperity Partners, where their professionals continue to advise attorneys, investors, family offices, real estate developers and executives nationwide.

description_html: Since 1974, Farkouh, Furman & Faccio (“FF&F”) has provided customized solutions for its clients’ most complex tax, financial and business matters. Core services include tax compliance and advisory; assurance; M&A; general business consulting; startup services; and outsourced accounting. Additionally, FF&F has a robust international tax practice, servicing individuals and businesses on complex cross-border tax planning and compliance matters. From domestic and international businesses of all sizes to high-net-worth individuals and families, clients rely on the firm’s personalized service and tailored strategies to maximize efficiency and profitability. For over 50 years, FF&F has been proud to offer the technical expertise usually associated with Big 4 firms, delivered with the superior client service that only a small firm can provide. Our late 2025 merger established Prosperity’s New York flagship office and brought assurance and international tax expertise to the growing firm while leveraging Prosperity’s robust technology investments and domestic and offshore resources.

name: Washington DC – Tax
description_html: Founded in 1980, Wiener & Garg LLC has been a trusted leader in the Washington, DC metro area, specializing in real estate and custom-built tax planning and compliance solutions. In 2024, the firm merged with Prosperity Partners, expanding its capabilities and reach. Under the leadership of Subhash Garg, who heads the firm’s Real Estate practice, and Vikesh Bansal, who leads the Technology and Entrepreneurship practice, the firm offers enhanced services to real estate professionals, professional service providers, startups, tech companies, and entrepreneurs.
